study_role: public price-domain repair; source validation followed by fixed paid-prefix development replay
price_prior: previous source second moments in billing coefficients, transported to prices; Gaussian residual about the public price midpoint, restricted to the public box
pooled_price_control: same coefficient trace and public midpoint/box, with isotropic billing coefficient covariance
uniform_price_control: uniform on the identical public box; no learned price covariance
zero_mean_contract_change: absolute price means now equal the public midpoint; price residuals have zero prior mean by symmetry; all arms receive the same public reference function
support: four billing functions frozen from previous source selection; zero residual variance frozen from previous source study
eta_prior: unchanged U1 source spectral and same-source full dictionary; pooled-risk control uses full dictionary only
fallback: equal initial weight on bounded billing and original unbounded 72-function fallback; identical fallback within matched pricing contrasts
numerical_gate: refine the same observed prefixes; identical recommendations and at most 0.003 difference in maximum predicted utility; otherwise retain numerical failure and increase integration resolution before scoring
likelihood: exact Normal sample mean and log-chi-square sample variance conditional on prices; Gaussian eta moments projected after each batch
proposal: correlated Gaussian weighted-regression proposal conditioned sequentially on the public box, with twice the proposal covariance for g integration; importance weights divide out the proposal; saved plug-in noise is used only for placement, never as known constraint mean noise in inference
shared_decision_rule: unchanged Gaussian moment verification utility and centered 27-node KG; probes unexecuted
